# Session Reflection Build Brief
**AI-generated by:** Alson (A.I Agent)

Implement the approved session Reflection tab for authenticated users who can access a published, non-archived Learning Session.

The feature stores one required plain-text reflection per participant and session, limited to 5,000 characters. Anyone with access to the session can read submitted reflections. Authors can edit or delete their own reflection. Administrators can delete any reflection but cannot edit another person's words.

The change includes the data model, protected routes, server validation and authorization, activity events, the third session tab, list and form UI, safe text rendering, status and validation feedback, and focused regression coverage. It excludes comments, reactions, notifications, grading, exports, and separate reporting.

Acceptance is the approved Gherkin in [`artifacts/session-reflection-bdd.md`](../../../../artifacts/session-reflection-bdd.md). The existing Session Materials, Q&A, recording, authentication, and session visibility behavior must continue to work.
